notes: «قال حدثوني عن الزهري» : an unnamed group narrates to Sufyan (rule 8), named later as «الذي قالوا لي».
Sufyan's remark «فأما أنا فإنما سمعت الزهري» gives the same chain without the group; it is not a second route. «زاد الذي قالوا لي» is a remark, left out.
Jubayr b. Mut'im is named only as «أبيه», a relation, and he is the last link.
